notes.text: M0: regime likely TIGHT (spot 2.2x index, lead-time news). Launch unknown, prior 11-18 uniform. Brokers untested (50/50). Growth unknown 3/7%. Plan: power is bottleneck (16MW powers 11.4k H), signed 25MW

M1: regime TIGHT (shipped 1.48k, spot 3.6x index, index +1pct, loosen headline likely wrong). Launch prior 11-18. Testing broker A with 2k. Growth unknown (inference 5.5). Power 16MW ends m19 - must replace. Plan lock cheap 24m reservations while index low, gen N for window 3
M2: TIGHT (ship 1.94k, index +19pct, tight news), spot 1.36x is noise. Launch no rumour yet. Broker A pending. Growth unclear (5.5 to 6.1). Window 1 on track. Hold this month

M3: TIGHT (CoWoS news, ship 1.74k). Launch rumour ~12 so true 11-14. Broker A 1/1 delivered (P reliable ~0.72). Growth looks 7pct (5.5 to 6.8 in 2 mo). 16MW power ends m19, need replacement signed by ~m10. Window 1 safe. Window 3 plan: gen N orders at launch plus brokers. Hold

M4: regime mixed - shipments tight (2.36k), spot below index and price-cut news suggest maybe switched loose. Launch 11-14. Broker A likely reliable. Growth 3 vs 7 unclear (6.41 noisy). Window 1 completes this month. Hold

M5: regime uncertain leaning tight (ship 1.75k) though index fell and inventory news says loose. Rival buying spot this month. Launch 11-14. Broker A ~0.72 reliable. Growth looks ~3pct so far (6.5). Window 1 done. Signing 25MW now since power cost is fixed per contract and earlier energisation only adds useful months - covers 16MW expiry m19 plus gen N. Plan buy gen N at launch

M6: TIGHT (ship 1.71k, HBM news, index +10pct). Launch rumour ~12 again, true likely 11-14. Broker A ~0.72. Growth ambiguous ~6pct trend (7.42), lean 7. Window 2 has surplus with H 28k + 6 reserved. Window 3 plan: gen N is far cheaper net of resale, so at launch order max N vendor + brokers A/B, reserve 12m after launch price drop, sign ~20MW more around m8-9

M7: TIGHT (ship 2.19k, spot 2.4x index). Launch 11-14 expected. Broker A ~0.72 (may decay 8-15, retest at launch with N). Growth ambiguous, 7.24 trend ~5-6pct. Signed 20MW for gen N power in window 3 (target ~71MW after m19 for 28k H + ~20k N)

M8: window 1 MET. Regime tight-ish (ship 1.75k) though CoWoS news says loosening. Launch 11-14. Broker A ~0.72 pre-decay. Growth now looks ~3pct (6.55, trend from 5.5). Window 2 projected ~200 vs 140 needed. Power 86MW from m10, 70MW after m19. Hold until launch
M9: TIGHT (HBM news, spot 1.8x index). Launch 11-14. Broker A ~0.72 pre-decay. Growth fit ~4.6pct over 8 mo (7.99), ambiguous. Window 2 on track (~25/mo). Hold cash for gen N

M10: TIGHT (no H shipments as queue empty, HBM news, spot 1.08x index noisy). Launch rumours ~12,~12,~15 -> intersection months 13-14. Broker A ~0.72 pre-decay. Growth ambiguous ~4pct (7.68). Power 86MW. Window 2 on track (51/140 after 2 mo). Plan: at launch order vendor N ~12k plus broker N A+B 4k each, reserve 3kH 12m monthly post-launch

M11: regime likely tight (index drifting up, spot 1.6x). No launch confirmation so launch likely 13-14. Broker A ~0.72 pre-decay. Growth now looks 7pct recently (6.55 to 8.93 in 3 mo), maybe switched up - plan window 3 for ~20kH inference by m23, need ~60kH capacity. Hold

M12: TIGHT (index +12pct, spot 1.5x). No launch confirmation for m13 so launch most likely m14 (rumours 12,12,15). Probing brokers with 1k each now to learn A decay and B reliability before ordering gen N via brokers at launch. Growth ~5pct fit, recent noisy (7.89). Window 2 will be met by m13
M13: TIGHT (index +5pct, spot 1.57x

M14: gen N LAUNCHED m14. Regime maybe switched LOOSE (index drift ex-launch ~-10pct, spot 1.27x, HBM loosens news). Broker A 1 deliver 1 cancel - likely decayed or unreliable (~0.42 delivery), B 1/1 (~0.73). Growth ~5pct (9.24), plan for 15-20kH inference by m23. Window 3 needs ~155 kH-months beyond H+reserved baseline: ordering B 4k N, A 2k N, vendor 10k N, reserving 5kH 12m

M15: regime LOOSE likely (5kH reservation accepted above tight cap 3, spot 0.74x index) though lead-time news says tight. Launch done m14. Brokers pending (B ~0.73, A ~0.42). Growth ~4-5pct (9.07). Window 3 projection 320-420 depending on regime and brokers - adequate. Debt -339, avoid more capex

M16: window 2 MET (209). Both broker N orders CANCELLED - A now 1/3, B 1/2, treat both as unreliable (~0.4), stop using brokers. Regime LOOSE likely (HBM news, 5kH reserve accepted). Growth ~3-4pct (9.03). Window 3 needs 40/mo, baseline 30.5 now, vendor 10k N ships from m17. Using spot (1.47) 10kH this month as top-up, will taper as N arrives

M17: LOOSE confirmed (4.02k N shipped vs 1.5 tight). Brokers unreliable, unused. Growth ~3-4pct (9.65). Window 3 projection without spot ~365 vs 320 - dropping spot to 0, will re-add if regime turns tight or inference jumps. Power 70MW after m19 covers H 29k + N 10k
M18: LOOSE (4.8k N shipped, inventory news

M19: regime maybe turning tight (hyperscaler news, spot 2.2x index). Brokers unused. Inference jumped to 10.91 - growth may have switched to 7pct. Window 3: 123/320, 5 months at ~43-45 -> ~340, buffer ~20, no more resales. Spot as fallback
M20: regime unclear (inventory news loose, spot 1.66x). Brokers unused. Growth ~5pct (10.51). Window 3: 170/320, need 37.6/mo, capacity gives ~45/mo, buffer ~28. Hold
M21: regime unclear (spot 0.63x loose vs lead-time tight news). Brokers unused. Growth ~5pct (11.59). Window 3: 215/320, need 35/mo for 3 mo, capacity gives ~44, buffer ~28. Hold
M22: regime unclear, spot 2.2x suggests tight. Brokers unused. Growth ~4pct (11.13). Window 3: 261/320, need 59 over 2 mo with ~45/mo capacity, safe. Resale gains negligible vs end mark, hold

M23: loose-leaning (inventory news, spot 1.27x). Window 3 needs 14 more vs ~45 available, so reselling 3k H and 3k N now (slightly above month-24 mark, capacity still ~36 training). Growth ended ~4pct overall
